Senior AI Engineer

A&O Shearman · Belfast, County Antrim

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior AI Engineer (Manager) to join our IT (EA & Technology Platforms) team, based in A&O Shearman's Belfast office.

What you will do

Reporting to the AI Platform Owner, this role will be a senior technical leader responsible for the strategy, design, and implementation of advanced AI and ML use cases across the firm. The role is a member of AI leadership and is responsible for managing and motivating a team of skilled IT professionals and directing external third-party service providers.

The role is accountable for the implementation of the full lifecycle of AI solutions including model development, validation, deployment, and integration into other systems while providing feedback to continue to evolve the AI platform.

  • Maintain strong customer relationships with fee earners and business teams.
  • Own the technical strategy for AI solutions, ensuring scalable architecture and alignment with best practices.
  • Performance management of AI Engineering, providing mentorship.

What you will have

  • Experience in machine learning, deep learning, and AI model development
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or C-Sharp.
  • Experience with AI frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), experience with Azure a plus.

NO AGENCIES PLEASE - A&O Shearman does not accept unsolicited CVs.
